sender.sl: Nov »prijatelj« z družbenega omrežja ali zmenkarske strani (inženir na ladji, vojak, zdravnik v tujini)
sender.en: A new “friend” from social media or a dating site (ship engineer, soldier, doctor abroad)

name.sl: Ljubezenska prevara: ljubezen na daljavo in prošnje za denar
name.en: Romance scam: long-distance love and requests for money

how.sl: Na družbenem omrežju ali zmenkarski strani vas ogovori privlačna oseba, ki dela daleč stran, na primer kot inženir na ladji ali zdravnik v tujini. Tedne ali mesece vam posveča pozornost in izraža globoka čustva. Nato se pojavi težava: carina, bolnišnica, zamrznjen račun ali letalska vozovnica za obisk. Prosi za denar, darila ali podatke bančnega računa, pogosto v več nakazilih. Ko denarja ni več, izgine. Včasih vas prepriča tudi v »skupno« kripto naložbo.
how.en: On social media or a dating site an attractive person who works far away, for example as a ship engineer or a doctor abroad, starts talking to you. For weeks or months they shower you with attention and deep feelings. Then a problem comes up: customs, a hospital, a frozen account or a plane ticket to visit. They ask for money, gifts or bank details, often in several transfers. When the money stops, they disappear. Sometimes they also talk you into a “shared” crypto investment.

text.sl: Oseba, ki je nikoli niste srečali, hitro izraža ljubezen.
text.en: Someone you have never met quickly declares love.

text.sl: Nikoli ne more na video klic ali srečanje.
text.en: They can never video call or meet.

text.sl: Pojavi se nujna težava, ki jo reši le vaš denar.
text.en: An urgent problem appears that only your money can solve.

text.sl: Prosi za nakazila, darila ali podatke računa.
text.en: They ask for transfers, gifts or account details.

text.sl: Ljuba moja, ne morem verjeti, da sem te našel. Ko pristanemo v pristanišču, bom prvič po dolgem času svoboden in prvo letalo bo k tebi. Samo carina mi je zadržala paket z mojimi prihranki, potrebujem 2.300 evrov za takso. Tega ne povej nikomur, ne bi razumeli najine ljubezni. Vrnem ti vse, ko pridem.
text.en: My love, I can’t believe I found you. When we dock I’ll be free for the first time in ages and the first plane will be to you. Only customs is holding a package with my savings and I need 2,300 euros for the fee. Don’t tell anyone, they wouldn’t understand our love. I’ll pay you back everything when I come.

en: met someone online who asks for money
ship engineer boyfriend asked for a transfer
never video calls but asks for money
customs fee for his package romance
dating site match asked me to send money

sl: Nekdo, ki ga niste nikoli srečali, prosi za denar.
Izogiba se video klicu in srečanju.
Prosi vas, da o zvezi ne govorite z nikomer.
Zgodbe o carini, bolnišnici ali zamrznjenem računu se ponavljajo.
en: Someone you have never met asks for money.
They avoid video calls and meeting.
They ask you not to tell anyone about the relationship.
Stories about customs, hospitals or frozen accounts keep coming.

sl: Ne pošiljajte denarja ali podatkov. Prekinite stik, takoj ko posumite.
Shranite vsa sporočila in potrdila o nakazilih ter prijavite prevaro policiji.
Ne sramujte se: goljufi so izurjeni. Če ste nakazali, obvestite banko.
en: Don’t send money or details. Cut contact as soon as you suspect.
Keep all messages and transfer receipts and report the scam to the police.
Don’t feel ashamed: scammers are skilled. If you sent money, tell your bank.
